speaker: hero
text: Bit, AI wrote my dad's birthday speech. It's so *boring*.

speaker: bit
text: One line. It knows *nothing* about your dad.

speaker: bit
text: So it writes a speech for *any* dad.

speaker: hero
text: So I have to write *everything* myself?

speaker: bit
text: Ask me five questions first. *One at a time*.

speaker: bit
text: Now it asks what only *you* know.

speaker: hero
text: His worst joke? Oh, I have *ten*.

speaker: bit
text: Perfect. One at a time keeps the answers *short*.

speaker: bit
text: Then step two: tell it the *tone* and length.

speaker: bit
text: Details. Tone. *Length*. That's the whole script.

speaker: bit
text: Cover letters. Gift ideas. Trip plans. *Anything* personal.

speaker: bit
text: Follow for one AI trick a day.
